name: AskAny – AI-Powered Chat Assistant
author: wpazleen

sections.description:
AskAny – AI Chatbot for WooCommerce & WordPress is the most advanced AI chat assistant featuring breakthrough SSE technology, powered by OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Gemini. This revolutionary chatbot delivers instant responses, reduced server load, and seamless communication that transforms your customer support experience.

Whether you run a WooCommerce store or a content-rich WordPress site, AskAny combines AI chat, PDF search, and contextual understanding to provide the most intelligent customer support chatbot experience.

Why AskAny Is the Ultimate AI Chatbot for WooCommerce & WordPress

⚡ Revolutionary Real-Time Chat (Industry First!)

AskAny is the only AI chatbot that uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) for true real-time performance.

  • 🔥 90% Less Server Load — No more heavy polling, ultra-light performance
  • 🌐 True Real-Time Messaging — Replies appear instantly, like WhatsApp or Telegram
  • 🛡️ Automatic Fallback Mode — Smoothly switches to polling if SSE isn’t supported
  • 📱 Zero Configuration — Works instantly, no technical setup needed
  • 🌍 External Website Indexing — Crawl and index external websites to feed your AI assistant with extended knowledge

AskAny delivers 30x faster responses than traditional chatbot plugins — combining speed, accuracy, and real-time intelligence.

💬 24/7 AI Chat Support That Never Sleeps

AskAny acts as a smart support agent that’s always online — answering questions, browsing content, and even handling WooCommerce interactions.

  • 🤖 AI chat powered by OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Gemini
  • 👥 Assign real support agents for hybrid human + AI chat
  • 🔄 Seamless AI-to-Agent conversation handover
  • 🌙 AI takeover during off-hours or weekends
  • 💾 Every conversation saved in your dashboard

Your visitors always get the best of both worlds: instant AI assistance or human chat support when needed.

🛍️ Designed for WooCommerce Success

AskAny isn’t just a chatbot it’s your AI sales assistant.
It understands your product catalog, pricing, and stock in real-time.

  • 🛒 Show product cards with images, price, and stock info
  • 🧭 Smart product recommendations and upselling
  • 🗂️ Fetch product info directly in chat
  • 💬 Add to cart directly from the chat window
  • 📦 Reduce repetitive pre-sale questions

Drive more sales while cutting down manual support automatically.

📄 Intelligent Document & PDF Search

AskAny’s Document AI allows users to search through uploaded manuals, policies, or guides right inside chat.

  • 📚 Upload PDFs or documents to serve as your knowledge base
  • 🧠 AskAny extracts contextual answers using AI
  • 🔍 Combine document-based results with AI chat for precise responses

Perfect for knowledge bases, policy documentation, or training materials.

🌐 External Website Crawling & Indexing

Go beyond your WordPress site.
With AskAny’s External Website Indexing, you can connect and crawl external websites to expand your AI’s knowledge.

  • 🌍 Add URLs or entire domains to index their content
  • 🔎 Allow your AI to reference information from trusted sources
  • 🧩 Combine internal + external data for richer AI responses
  • 🧠 Perfect for multi-brand support, documentation hubs, and SaaS integrations

Empower your AI to understand your whole digital ecosystem — not just one site.

🧾 Forms Inside the Chatbot (No Reload Needed)

Enable any form plugin directly inside the chat widget:
(Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Simple Form, etc.)

  • 💡 Capture leads instantly
  • 🗣️ Run surveys and polls
  • 💬 Handle feedback and support queries
  • ⚙️ No page reloads or popups

Keep users engaged and capture valuable information effortlessly.

🧠 AI That Understands Your Website

AskAny is designed specifically for WordPress and deeply integrated with your site’s data.

  • 📄 Reads and understands pages, posts, and FAQs
  • 🏷️ Handles WooCommerce products natively
  • 📚 Supports PDF search for document-based responses
  • ⚙️ Integrates OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Gemini for intelligence
  • 🎯 Customizable Q&A logic and behavior

Your users get contextual, relevant, and instant answers every time.

🚀 Key Benefits

  • ✅ Built-in Agent Management system
  • ✅ Hybrid chatbot with real-time human agents + full AI chat fallback
  • ✅ Reduce Customer Support load
  • ✅ Boost WooCommerce sales with smart upselling
  • ✅ Enable AI chat on every page
  • ✅ Power your chatbot with OpenAI or DeepSeek
  • ✅ Let users search your documents via PDF search
  • ✅ Keep your users engaged longer

If you’re ready to transform your site with real-time customer support, smarter AI chat, and powerful WooCommerce integration, AskAny is your all-in-one chatbot plugin. Built with OpenAI, DeepSeek, and powerful PDF search, it’s the ultimate way to automate and scale your support.

Let the chatbot do the work—while you grow your business.

Key Features

  • Advanced AI Integration

    • Dual AI model support (OpenAI and DeepSeek)
    • Smart fallback system for uninterrupted service
    • Context-aware responses based on conversation history
    • Natural language processing for better understanding

  • Comprehensive Knowledge Base

    • Automatic WordPress content indexing
    • PDF document processing and integration
    • WooCommerce product integration
    • Custom Q&A pair management

  • E-commerce Integration

    • Smart product recommendations
    • Interactive product cards in chat
    • Price and availability information
    • Direct “Add to Cart” functionality
    • Product search and filtering

  • Chat Interface

    • Modern, responsive design
    • Customizable chat widget
    • Emoji support
    • Chat history persistence
    • Clear chat functionality

  • Customization Options

    • Customizable widget position
    • Adjustable Home page Icon, Wigets Icons
    • Custom welcome messages
    • Suggested questions

  • Backend Chat Management

    • Admins can view all user conversations
    • All chats are stored in the database

  • User List & Agent Management

    • View all registered users
    • Easily assign or remove agent roles

  • AI-to-Agent Live Chat Handover

    • Agents can take over AI conversations in real-time
    • Smooth transition between AI and human support

  • Live Chat Statistics Dashboard

    • Visual breakdown of chat performance
    • Total sessions
    • Active sessions (last 24h)
    • Total messages
    • AI-handled vs. Agent-handled interactions

  • Dedicated Home Page Settings

    • Show agents with profiles
    • Custom welcome message
    • Link documentation section on homepage

  • FAQ & Custom Links Management

    • Add and display FAQ on the homepage
    • Add custom links for quick access

Use Cases

  1. Customer Support

    • Answer product queries
    • Provide shipping information
    • Handle return policy questions
    • Assist with technical support

  2. E-commerce Assistant

    • Product recommendations
    • Price inquiries
    • Stock availability
    • Order tracking assistance

  3. Knowledge Base

    • FAQ automation
    • Document search
    • Policy information
    • Technical documentation

  4. Website Guide

    • Navigation assistance
    • Content discovery
    • Feature explanation
    • Service information

Privacy Notes

The AI Assistant accesses the API interface of your chosen provider (OpenAI, DeepSeek, or Google Gemini) to generate responses based on your indexing Content, PDF, and Q&A.

Data is sent to and retrieved from the following interfaces:

  • https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
  • https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions
  • https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent

Policy Information

Please review the full terms of use and data protection policies for the AI providers you choose to use:

  • OpenAI: OpenAI Policies
  • DeepSeek AI: DeepSeek AI Terms of Service
  • Google Gemini:
    • Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
    • Google API Services User Data Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/askany directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure the plugin settings in the AskAny menu
  4. Add your AI API keys (OpenAI or DeepSeek)
  5. Index your content and upload relevant PDFs
  6. Add the chat widget using shortcode or automatic placement

API Key

To obtain an API key for the AI Assistant, you must register with one of the following providers:

  • OpenAI: Register with Open AI or log in to obtain your key.
    • Find your key here: Open AI API Key Location
  • DeepSeek: Register with DeepSeek or log in to obtain your key.
  • Google Gemini: Log in to Google AI Studio to generate and manage your Gemini API key.
sections.faq:
Which AI models are supported?

AskAny currently supports OpenAI and DeepSeek AI models. You can choose either provider or switch between them.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, AskAny seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce to provide product information, pricing, and shopping assistance.

Can it read PDF documents?

Yes, AskAny can process and index PDF documents, making their content accessible through the chat interface.

How is chat history handled?

Chat history is stored locally in the user’s browser and automatically expires after 7 days. Users can also clear their chat history manually.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, AskAny is designed with privacy in mind. All data processing is transparent, and no personal information is stored without consent.
